purpose: Generate reproducible candidate match keys without asserting legal-entity identity.

steps.warning: This is a retrieval key only; it is not a display-name transformation.

outputs.punctuation_name_key: Key after lowercase, punctuation folding, and whitespace normalization.
outputs.legal_suffix_name_key: Punctuation key after terminal legal-suffix canonicalization.

required_additional_evidence: compatible organization role and process context
negative_evidence: incompatible local-government location or organizational unit

excluded_transformations: abbreviation expansion outside the terminal legal suffix
